mapper.select: SELECT release_id, version_no, status, created_by, approved_by, published_at, created_at FROM config_release ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no), 0) + 1 FROM config_release FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO config_release (release_id, version_no, status, config_json, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{releaseId}, #{version}, 'DRAFT', #{config}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE config_release SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt} WHERE release_id = #{releaseId} AND status = 'APPROVED'
UPDATE config_release SET status = 'DISABLED' WHERE release_id <> #{releaseId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.select: SELECT config_json FROM config_release WHERE version_no < #{version} ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT release_id, version_no, status, created_by, approved_by, published_at, created_at FROM config_release WHERE release_id = #{releaseId}
SELECT version_no, CAST(config_json AS CHAR) AS config_json FROM config_release WHERE release_id = #{releaseId}
